constraint_alternatives.description: The same binary assertion may be encoded in inverse direction only when its endpoints are swapped; all partitions, evidence, temporal, and epistemic fields remain identical.

alternatives.equivalence_rule: One closed joint representation: inverse direction requires swapped endpoints and preserves every other semantic field.
alternatives.matching_rule: Compare the complete canonical joint signature; partial hybrids are invalid.
